Shipped model (`models/final_model.joblib`) with its isotonic calibrator. Thresholds act on the CALIBRATED score (flag when score >= threshold) and are chosen on VALIDATION only; every figure below is on the TEST split with 95% percentile bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples of test rows, threshold held fixed). Target is the proxy `Late_delivery_risk`, not RTO.

Candidate thresholds are the distinct validation calibrated scores (the calibrator is a step function); ties on the objective resolve to the lowest threshold. Different objectives can select the same threshold.

## Review capacity (top-k% by raw score, TEST)

Test prevalence is 55.05%, so lift = precision / 0.5505. Recall is the share of all late orders that fall inside the reviewed slice.

| Review share | Orders reviewed | Precision | Recall | Lift |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10% | 987 | 1.0000 | 0.1818 | 1.816x |
| 20% | 1,973 | 0.9392 | 0.3413 | 1.706x |
| 30% | 2,959 | 0.8895 | 0.4847 | 1.616x |
| 40% | 3,946 | 0.8302 | 0.6033 | 1.508x |

Because the label is near rule-based (see `MODEL_CARD.md`), the top slice is dominated by First Class orders; high top-k precision reflects that structure rather than courier insight.
